'''Samuel David Young''' (born [[May 31]], [[1985]] in [[Clinton, Maryland]]) is an American professional basketball player for the Utah Jazz of the National Basketball Association. The Utah Jazz selected him with the 20th pick of the 2009 NBA Draft. Young played collegiately at the University of Pittsburgh,

==College career==
He attended [[Hargrave Military Academy]] after graduating high school for a year and joined the Pitt basketball team for the 2005-2006 season.<ref>[http://pittsburghpanthers.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/young_sam00.html University of Pittsburgh Official Athletic Site<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> Young was the [[2008 Big East Tournament]] MVP for the 2008 season after scoring 80 points in the tournament. Sam Young finished the 2007-2008 season averaging 18 points per game.<ref>[http://www.usatoday.com/sports/college/mensbasketball/bigeast/pittsburgh.htm USATODAY.com<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/columns/story?columnist=glockner_andy&id=3439704|title=Senior class has rare depth, breadth and quality}}</ref>

In his senior season at Pitt, Young averaged 19.2 points per game, and was given the honor of being a Third Team All-America. His 2009 NBA draft stock also increased after his spectacular performance in the 2009 NCAA Tournament in which he averaged 23.5 points in four games, and he is now expected to be selected in the front half of the first round. <ref>http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/player/profile?playerId=27299</ref>  <ref>http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/news/story?id=4027698</ref>  <ref>http://www.nbadraft.net/2009mock_draft</ref>
